answer:
The largest aircraft carrier in the world is the **USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78)**, and it is named after **Gerald R. Ford**, the 38th President of the United States. 

Ford had a notable connection to naval service; he served as a lieutenant commander in the U.S. Navy during World War II and trained as a pilot aboard the light aircraft carrier USS Monterey (CVL-26). The USS Gerald R. Ford, commissioned in 2017, represents the eighth U.S. Navy vessel to bear his name and is recognized as both the largest aircraft carrier and the largest warship ever built.
